The '''Drearian Defense Conglomerate''' was a mid-sized company on [[Drearia/Legends|Drearia]] that specialized in high-quality [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and rifles, and was known for supplying the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

Drearian was well-known in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It also provided armaments for [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturers including [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] and [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
